thread:
maria: Summarizing postmortem follow-ups from yesterday's authz outage. Root cause: token-validator GC pause causing JWKS fetch threads to block and cascade validation failures. Need explicit owners for hotfix, audit logging changes, secrets/service-principal rotation, and a short recurrence/verification plan. Please update the tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-2026-318 recorded: authz validation spike 2026-03-22 11:12-11:48 UTC. Affected: hosted API + dedicated eu-west-1 customers. Severity: P2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: I'll take the hotfix to add a non-blocking JWKS fetch path, cache fallback, and a simple circuit-breaker. Target: patch to staging by 03/26 EOD, canary 03/27 morning.

alex: I'll own telemetry, alert tuning, and the audit event additions. Plan: add jwks_fetch_latency histogram, emit authz.audit events with token_hash (hashed) and verdict. PR to staging today.

tanya: I'll prepare customer comms templates and wait for jamie's canary success before sending.

maria: Tracker rows added. Please populate sub-tasks and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. Key items I added: hotfix (jamie) -> 03/26 EOD; telemetry+alerts (alex) -> 03/28; audit schema + retention review (alex+devsec) -> 03/28; rotate token-validator service principal + verify secrets (devsec) -> 03/28 window; comms (tanya) -> after canary verification.

jamie: Technical notes: immediate mitigation is GC tuning (G1 target pause <200ms) and lowering heap headroom. Also make JWKS fetch use async IO so network stalls don't block validation threads. Medium-term: extract JWKS fetch into a tiny sidecar with separate connection limits and its own process-level OOM/GC boundaries. I'll add a runbook snippet to the sheet.

alex: For audit telemetry, propose index authz.audit with fields: tenant_id, subject_id, token_hash, jwks_fetch_latency_ms, verdict, error_code, cached_jwks_age_s. Example search to distinguish tenant-caused vs platform issues:
```
index=authz.audit (error_code=JWKS_FETCH_FAIL OR error_code=TOKEN_VALIDATION_ERROR) | stats count by error_code, tenant_id
```
I'll wire the histogram + events today and add alert thresholds to avoid noisy paging.

ops-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: token-validator v2.1 -> 03/27 02:30 UTC to 5% canary. Auto-rollback if >1% validation fail rate for 10m.

devsec-bot: Remediation ticket RDW-SEC-12458 created: rotate service principal used by token-validator and validate secret material. Proposed maintenance window 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maria: Proposal: short-lived "token health" review cadence: weekly 15-min sync starting Mon 03/30 for 6 weeks or until metrics stabilise. I'll send invites and add an agenda: metric review, outstanding actions, and any tenant anomalies. Please ack in-thread and confirm tracker ownership.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed. Runbook snippet (will paste full runbook to tracker by EOD Fri):
```
# token-validator fallback
if jwks_fetch_latency_ms > 500:
  use_cached_jwks()
  backoff_jwks_fetch()
  emit_metric("jwks.fetch.fail")
if cached_jwks_age_s > 60:
  page("eng-oncall")
```
Also adding rollback steps and post-deploy validation queries.

tanya: :thumbsup: I'll hold comms until canary success and then prepare segmented messages for impacted dedicated customers. Add me to the tracker as comms owner.

alex: Also adding an automated nightly job for 2 weeks to sample token validation across a synthetic tenant set to detect regressions early. Will add job details to the tracker.

maria: Recap of immediate owners & dates (reply with :eyes: to confirm):
1) jamie: hotfix + runbook (03/26 EOD)
2) alex: telemetry + alerts + audit schema (03/28)
3) devsec: rotate service principal + secrets verification (03/28 window)
4) tanya: comms after canary verification
5) cadence: weekly token-health check-ins starting 03/30 for 6 weeks

If any dates slip, update the sheet and ping me. Thanks everyone for the quick response and cleanup.
